name: csv-ledger
objective: Normalize CSV ledger rows and aggregate exact decimal amounts
task: Implement parse_ledger(text) accepting a CSV string with exact header date,category,amount. Return a list of dicts with ISO calendar-valid YYYY-MM-DD date (reject noncanonical formats), nonempty stripped category and amount string quantized to two decimal digits with Decimal(str(x)) ROUND_HALF_UP. Preserve row order and Unicode. Reject malformed headers/row widths/invalid dates/nonfinite or malformed amounts with ValueError. Blank input is invalid; header alone returns []. Implement totals(rows) over parse_ledger output, aggregating by category with Decimal, returning a dict inserted in lexicographic category order and values as two-decimal strings. Negative amounts are allowed. Implement CLI: python module.py reads CSV from stdin; print JSON {"rows":...,"totals":...} ensure_ascii=False; invalid input -> exit2 and concise stderr without traceback. Document API, CLI, validation, exact Decimal rounding, Unicode and official reference. Modify module.py and README.md only. Never edit tests/build/.autopilot. Run python test_module.py and python build.py.

import unittest,subprocess,sys,json
from module import parse_ledger,totals
class Acceptance(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_stage_specific_amount(self):
  self.assertEqual(totals(parse_ledger('date,category,amount
2024-01-01,Task,16.125
')),{'Task':'16.13'})

 def test_rows_unicode_and_rounding(self):
  r=parse_ledger('date,category,amount
2024-02-29, Café ,1.005
2024-03-01,"Comida, casa",-2.675
')
  self.assertEqual(r,[{'date':'2024-02-29','category':'Café','amount':'1.01'},{'date':'2024-03-01','category':'Comida, casa','amount':'-2.68'}])
 def test_aggregate(self):
  self.assertEqual(totals(parse_ledger('date,category,amount
2024-01-01,Z,0.10
2024-01-01,A,0.20
2024-01-02,Z,0.20
')),{'A':'0.20','Z':'0.30'})
  self.assertEqual(list(totals([{'date':'2024-01-01','category':'Z','amount':'1.00'},{'date':'2024-01-01','category':'A','amount':'1.00'}])),['A','Z'])
 def test_header_only(self):self.assertEqual(parse_ledger('date,category,amount
'),[])
 def test_invalid(self):
  for s in ['', 'wrong,header
', 'date,category,amount
2023-02-29,X,1
','date,category,amount
2024-1-01,X,1
','date,category,amount
2024-01-01,,1
','date,category,amount
2024-01-01,X,NaN
','date,category,amount
2024-01-01,X,Infinity
','date,category,amount
2024-01-01,X,bad
','date,category,amount
2024-01-01,X
','date,category,amount
2024-01-01,X,1,extra
']:
   with self.subTest(s=s):
    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):parse_ledger(s)
 def test_cli(self):
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'module.py'],input='date,category,amount
2024-01-01,Ñ,1.005
',text=True,capture_output=True);self.assertEqual(p.returncode,0,p.stderr);self.assertEqual(json.loads(p.stdout)['totals'],{'Ñ':'1.01'})
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'module.py'],input='bad',text=True,capture_output=True);self.assertEqual(p.returncode,2);self.assertNotIn('Traceback',p.stderr)

 def test_documentation(self):
  from pathlib import Path
  text=Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');self.assertGreater(len(text),250);self.assertIn('module.py',text);self.assertIn('ValueError',text);self.assertIn('2',text)
if __name__=='__main__':
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(Acceptance))
 if result.wasSuccessful():print('ENDURANCE_TEST_PASS')
 raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
